purpose: Proxies that ARE available for Mason at/near impact. Face angle and club path are NOT available; see docs/IMPACT_FACE_PATH_AVAILABILITY.md.
unverified_reason: ~30 unique fps screen recordings of social-feed playback, monocular MediaPipe world landmarks, no club or ball tracking, impact event is landmark-inferred (+-~0.05 s), several clips edited/looped.

unavailable.face_angle_deg: requires club tracking or launch monitor
unavailable.face_to_path_deg: requires club tracking or launch monitor
unavailable.club_path_deg: requires club tracking or launch monitor
unavailable.attack_angle_deg: requires club tracking or launch monitor
unavailable.dynamic_loft_deg: requires club tracking or launch monitor

unavailable.launch_angle_deg: requires club tracking or launch monitor
unavailable.spin_rpm: requires club tracking or launch monitor

unavailable.ball_speed_mph: requires club tracking or launch monitor

low_point_t_minus_impact_s.use: reward_ready timing; implies the impact event is early vs hand low point

peak_hand_speed_torso_per_s.use: reward_ready relative hand speed; NOT mph (torso length unscaled)

hand_tgt_at_impact_torso_lengths.use: diagnostic only: target axis from monocular depth, only ~2-3 clips pass view-axis agreement

lead_arm_lean_at_impact_deg.use: diagnostic only: arm-line proxy not shaft lean; ~-58 deg is largely depth smear

hand_path_direction.oth: NOT usable: lateral sign is arbitrary per clip; weighted median lies outside its own IQR
hand_path_direction.note: Hand path direction in the swing plane is a weak hint at path, not club path (hands path != clubhead path).

lateral_spread.note: No Mason lateral-dispersion data; ball flight never observed. Lateral spread can only come from launch-monitor or sim shots.

handedness_flags.mason_v2_p1_s11: handedness_verified=False; geometry proxies from this clip inherit that caveat
